# LLMFirewall Core

> In-process, defense-in-depth security framework for Large Language Model (LLM) applications, RAG pipelines, and autonomous AI agents. Sub-millisecond latency (0.02ms P50), zero external network dependencies.

- Distribution: `llmfirewall-core` on PyPI (`pip install llmfirewall-core`)
- Python Import: `import llmfirewall`
- CLI Command: `llmfirewall`
- Version: `1.2.0`

## Documentation & Guides

- [Getting Started](docs/getting-started.md): 5-minute quickstart, scan methods, decision semantics, and safe logging.
- [Installation Guide](docs/installation.md): Installation options, virtual environments, pure ASGI setup, and optional extras.
- [Public API Reference](docs/api.md): Authoritative class definitions, methods, return types, and exceptions.
- [AI Coding Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Architectural trust boundaries, canonical imports, 7-step developer workflow, decision invariants, and test verification commands.
- [System Architecture](docs/architecture.md): 4-stage pipeline architecture (inspection, risk engine, policy engine, runtime defense).
- [Security Model & Threat Boundaries](docs/security-model.md): Threat vectors, fail-closed semantics, and zero-retention privacy.
- [Policy-as-Code](docs/policy-as-code.md): Declarative JSON/YAML rule authoring and policy validation.
- [CLI Reference](docs/cli.md): Comprehensive subcommands for CI/CD gates, scanning, and incident investigation.

## Integration Recipes

- [FastAPI Endpoint](docs/integrations/fastapi_endpoint.md): ASGI middleware and route-level dependency injection.
- [Flask Endpoint](docs/integrations/flask_endpoint.md): Flask extension with request lifecycle hooks.
- [Pure ASGI Middleware](docs/integrations/asgi_middleware.md): Zero-dependency ASGI 3.0 middleware (compatible with FastAPI, Starlette, Quart).
- [Streaming Text Guard](docs/integrations/streaming_guard.md): Boundary-aware sliding-window stream protection preventing split-token jailbreaks.
- [Agent Tool Calling](docs/integrations/agent_tool_calling.md): Sandboxing agent tool calls against SSRF, SQL injection, and path traversal.
- [RAG Ingestion Guard](docs/integrations/rag_context_guard.md): Document ingestion scanning, context budgeting, and poisoned chunk isolation.

## Developer Tooling & Verification

- CLI Developer Engine: `llmfirewall integrate detect`, `llmfirewall integrate scaffold`, `llmfirewall integrate validate`
- [Verified Sample Applications](examples/sample_apps/): Isolated reference implementations for FastAPI, ASGI, Streaming, Agent Tools, and RAG.
- [VS Code Developer Extension](ide/vscode/): Minimal extension for guidance, configuration validation, and test execution.
